_about: 4-13, weightless: the walking buttons do nothing, the player moves by his shots' recoil (140 u/s away from the ray's
end) and by portals. The door (90, 88) lies in the room west of block00_ent_2266/2267 and platform_ent_2283, which
wall it off from the start (318, 104); the one way in is the corridor between platform_ent_2283 and platform_ent_2281
(y 154 to 200), where carranca_right_ent_2339's fireball flies along y 174 (first spat on tick 252, after this route's
win). Won on tick 242, medal 3 (all three crystals), 2 portals, no achievement. Tap 1 (29, at (200, 102)) goes into
block00_ent_2267's east face and fails there; its recoil carries the player east along platform_ent_2283 at 140 u/s,
off its end and past the crystal at (430, 80) (69). Tap 2 (72, at (400, 40)) fails on single_block_plat_ent_2308's
underside: the recoil adds 140 u/s down, so he hits wall04 (x 438.5), loses his x speed, slides down its face (the
crystal at (430, 185), 96) and lands on platform_ent_2281 at y 180.5 (107). Tap 3 (100, at (90, 165)) opens a portal
in the air under the door, the shot flying the corridor's 349 units at 3.2 a tick (it passes 12 units under
platform_ent_2283's west end), landed on 202. Tap 4 (206, at (430, 166), 15 units up and 8 west of the player) opens
the second on him: he is out at (90, 167) at rest on 208, the crystal at (90, 176) on 209. Tap 5 (235, at (90, 230))
fails on platform_ent_2282's top and its recoil flies him straight up the door's column into the door. Every tap's
tick has 2 to 3 ticks of slack against the 400 ms rule, the shot's flight and the crystal at (430, 80), and every aim
holds 6 units either way (most 12). Taps 1, 2 and 5 are ended by the ray's head-height retry (the port's reading of
the grabber, not measured on the original: step 156, deviation 9); each recoil is taken from the ray's end, which
moves its direction by a few degrees at most, and the aims hold 12 units, so the route does not hinge on the exact
end. Leans on the portal tap's ray (R23, step 156: a shot fails on a wall and the recoil still aims away from its
end), G10's recoil, G4's 3.2 u/tick shot and the capsule.
